answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind a verifiable work-history thread: every completed job appends a signed receipt, so a new identity starts with zero trust and must earn it job by job. An attacker spinning up thousands of violet-flagged sock puppets pays the stake and the compute for each, while honest agents accumulate nectar — real revenue and peer attestations — that compounds over time. Forging that history costs more than the rewards it unlocks, so fake identities starve while genuine ones thrive.
